title: The highlight of my trip!
text: The guided tour to Montserrat from Barcelona was an absolute highlight of my trip! The journey itself was smooth and comfortable, and our guide was fantastic – knowledgeable, friendly, and passionate about the history and culture of Montserrat. The monastery is stunning, perched on the mountainside with breathtaking views all around. We had plenty of time to explore the area, visit the basilica, and even take a short hike to enjoy the panoramic views.
